Do not copy the damaged beige/green background pixels from the old cutout. Cat's lying body is about 1000 px wide, centered from x=140 to 1140; head and body low in the canvas, belly/paws resting at y=600, 40px above bottom edge; tail must remain visible within canvas. Reserve clear space above for later raised-head poses. This is the master identity reference for every later frame.

Use case: product-mockup. A single real paper hanging tag, photographed straight on for a website. Tall narrow portrait canvas 800 x 2000 px, tag about 2:5 width:height. Thick matte card stock with visible subtle paper fibers, slightly soft worn corners, a faint crease, very subtle shadows ON THE PAPER SURFACE ONLY. A round reinforced hole near the top with a small brass metal eyelet. A thin natural cotton string loops through the hole and goes straight up out of the top frame. Bottom edge cut into a V-shaped notch like a bookmark (swallowtail). Paper color: warm ivory, like old library card stock. Completely blank face: no text, no logo, no pattern, no illustration. Genuinely transparent PNG background with alpha. No cast/drop shadow on background. Soft natural light, realistic photograph, not a 3D render, not cartoon. Full tag visible with slim even side margins and bottom margin. Symmetrical front view, no rotation, no perspective. Long uninterrupted blank paper face for vertically overlaid webpage text.
